svg.title: FrontierLab architecture: From Flatland to Spaceland
svg.desc: Black-and-white pipeline diagram. Research question, evidence retrieval from Europe PMC and Springer Nature, optional Muse2-230M edge preprocessing, the Evidence Extraction Agent, and the deterministic verbatim evidence gate. An optional Llama 3.1 8B baseline runs the same contract for comparison. Figures and tables can pass an optional Liquid d1-2B multimodal evidence gate. All evidence then reaches the human review gate. Only after review do the Adversarial Skeptic Agent and Hypothesis Agent run, followed by researcher method evaluation, the planning gate, the plan draft and the JSON audit trail export.
svg.text: A question gains dimensions through agents, cross-checked evidence and human review
I · FLATLAND — TEXT ON THE PLANE
default path · the edge worker is optional
bound to source snapshots and the question
The reviewer plays the Sphere: the one
who sees each claim from outside the
plane of text, against its source.
Hexagon agents call one backend per run: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B via NVIDIA NIM (verified) or Muse Spark Open (optional frontier multimodal).
Every call has a hard budget and no automatic retries. Changing a source or the question invalidates downstream reviews, hypotheses, evaluations and plans.
Sphere · human review and researcher decisions
Visual homage to Edwin A. Abbott, Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions (1884, public domain). Shapes mark roles, not rank.
